ghidra: read-only: no rename, comment, prototype, function creation or save
subject: The free-flight arm of 007DB680, re-derived from the assembly listing and published as a pure rule: the four accumulators it writes, the fold that resolves them into a body-frame acceleration, and the acceptance test that pins lift against gravity.
reuses: docs/PLANE_FLIGHT_CORE_LAW.md sections 4.2 through 4.9, re-verified term by term
docs/GAME_TUNING_SINGLETON.md key table for the nine Dynamics/* rows
include/bsp/plane_flight.hpp: PlaneFlightHost, run_plane_fixed_step_007ce040, plane_class_flight_off, plane_dynamics_tuning_off, kDynamicsMirrorBase

answer.shape: 007DB680 is an accumulator pass, not an integrator. 007DB6B6 007D7C00 zeroes six 3-float accumulators at dyn+04h + 0Ch*k and copies ctl+18h/ctl+3Ch into dyn+4Ch/dyn+64h; 007DB680 adds one term per force into the accumulator that force's frame belongs to; 007DC6E6 007D8470 rotates each world accumulator into its body partner through ctl+0B0h and applies a 0.001f deadband. Free flight writes dyn+04h (body damping, ceiling forward push), dyn+10h (world drag), dyn+1Ch (body lift and thrust) and dyn+28h (world gravity and ceiling).
answer.matrix_direction: ctl+0B0h maps world to body. 007D9C2D-007D9C51 calls 0042D0D0 with EDX = ctl+18h, the world velocity 007D7C00 is handed, and stores the result into ctl+3Ch..44h, which 007DBD3A/007DBD50 pair with XDrag/YDrag as the body velocity; 007DC6DA hands 007D8470 that same ctl+0B0h, reaching it as [ESP+0x54] after SUB ESP,3Ch and three pushes.
answer.lift: aoa = (0.1 <= |vz|) ? -vy/vz : 0; q = (007D99C0(ctl) / desc+184h StallSpd) / LevelFlight * ctl+9Ch; qq = q < 1 ? q*q : 1; dyn+20h += min(clamp((1 + aoa) * qq, -2, 2) * AccelCheatMul, ctl+90h) * 9.81f.
answer.gravity: dyn+2Ch -= AccelCheatMul * 9.81f * InterpolateClamped(0, 1, LostDragTime, ExtraGravityMul, unit+0C3Ch), and when ctl+94h is set a second time by 9.81f * InterpolateClamped(1, 0, 2.5, 3, unit+0C3Ch) with no AccelCheatMul.
answer.cancellation: Both sides are the same float 1.5f * 9.81f once q >= 1, so lift cancels gravity exactly at and above forward speed 1.8 * StallSpd = 31.5 m/s for the installed Fighter row. Measured net world-up acceleration is 0.00000000 at 141.666672 m/s and at 31.5 m/s, -0.09327984 at 31.4, -8.78302670 at 20 and -14.71500015 at rest. Perturbing ctl+40h to -10 m/s raises the angle of attack to +0.0705882 and the net to +1.03870678: the model self-corrects.
answer.host_data: The model needed nothing the host cannot supply. The only authored class field the cancellation depends on is StallSpd, which 007D1F70 already parses; everything else is an image constant or a Dynamics/* row whose PlaneGlobals.lua default is recorded.

verification.producer_before_layout: Every authored field was traced to its producer before use: desc+184h/170h/174h to 007D1F70 (the key strings XDrag/YDrag pushed before each FSTP, per docs/PLANE_FLIGHT_CORE_LAW.md), and the nine Dynamics/* rows to 007EAAE1's REP MOVSD into 00F872F0. The mirror mapping was not assumed: 007D92B0 alone reads 00F87324, 00F87328 and 00F87308, which the mapping predicts as DragRangeMin, DragRangeMax and DragFuncPower, and the key table confirms all three.
verification.register_provenance: The three x87 stack traces were done by counting every push and pop over the whole block, not by reading the instruction nearest the use: 007DB89D-007DB9BB establishes that the gravity ramp's y0 = 1.0f is the FLD1 leftover from 007DB8E1; 007DBE50-007DBE79 that the ceiling fade's y1 = 0.0f is the FLDZ leftover from 007DBE54; 007DBB95-007DBC5C that the ctl+98h term's three components are (n.x*d, d*0.0, n.z*d), which is what disproves the merged transcription.
verification.byte_census: 00F87574 was checked for writers under two store encodings (D9 1D FSTP and F3 0F 11 05 MOVSS): no matches under either, 161 readers under F3 0F 10 05. The image bytes are zero, so 007D7C00 is a clear.
verification.argument_counts: 00419010 is RET 0x14 (five floats), 007D92B0 RET 4 (one float), 007D7C00 RET 8 plus ECX. 007D9050's three stack arguments were counted from PUSH ECX at 007DB787 plus SUB ESP,8 at 007DB78E, not from the decompiler.
verification.negative_results: No producer of ctl+94h was found (the previous packet also failed to find one); it is labelled a host input with no known writer. 0042D0D0's row/column convention was not re-read; the published fold declares its own and the acceptance test drives the identity case only.
verification.installation: Modded (BSPRM/AlterBSP): vehicleclasses.lua mtime 2026-05-09 against an untouched bulk of 2024-07-13. Nothing in this installation was modified; StallSpd 17.5 and TravelSpeed 141.666672 are quoted from docs/PLANE_FLIGHT.md, not re-read from the script.

corrections.is: dyn[0x10..0x18] += (n.x*d, d*0.0, n.z*d) * (ctl[0x98] - 1.0). Only the middle component is zeroed; the forward component survives.
corrections.evidence: At 007DBBF5 the x87 stack is ST0 = n.x*d, ST1 = n.z*d, ST2 = d, built at 007DBB95-007DBBC2. 007DBC03 FMUL double [00D7A258] multiplies d (not n.y*d) by the double 0.0 and 007DBC09 stores it as the middle component; 007DBC0D FSTP [ESP+0x38] keeps n.z*d, 007DBC3B FMUL [ESP+0x38] scales it by (ctl+98h - 1.0) and 007DBC55-007DBC5C adds it into dyn+18h. Inert in the shipped game: 007D7F5D leaves ctl+98h at 1.0f.

corrections.is: 00F87574-00F8757C is a read-only Vector3 zero constant outside the mirror. The mirror is 00F872F0-00F87427 (0x138 bytes, tuning +210h..+347h) per include/bsp/plane_flight.hpp, so 00F87574 is 0x14C past its end. The mapping is sound for every offset this law reads (all nine are inside the window) and must not be extrapolated past it.
corrections.evidence: A byte scan for stores to 00F87574 finds none under D9 1D (FSTP) or F3 0F 11 05 (MOVSS); 161 sites read it under F3 0F 10 05. The image bytes are zero. If it were the authored triple 20/60/80, 007D7C00 would preset every accumulator instead of clearing it and no term below would hold.

assumptions: 007D8470's integration tail 007D8624-007D904E is unread. The published rule returns accelerations and does not integrate; no velocity or position update in this repository is attributable to 007D8470.

0042D0D0's row/column convention was not re-read. fold_world_into_body_007d8470 declares its own (row-major, body = M * world). The acceptance test drives the identity case only; a non-level pose depends on the convention and is not covered.
007D9050 and 007D9140 enter as scalar inputs; their bodies are not reconstructed.
ctl+94h has no known producer. It is a host input.
XDrag and YDrag's installed values were not read; the test leaves them zero, so the damping term is untested against authored numbers.
No run-time evidence: the arm is not wired into bsp_game.exe's host yet (the integrator owns src/game_hosts_units.cpp), so checklist item 6 is satisfied vacuously.
prescription: Bind PlaneFlightHost::free_flight_007cc2f0 to accumulate_free_flight_007db680 followed by fold_world_into_body_007d8470, supplying thrust_accel and drag_accel from the host. The rule returns a body-frame acceleration; the integration step remains the host's until 007D8624-007D904E is read.
